profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Generalist full stack engineer and teacher with 10+ years of experience.
I have worked with multiple programming languages and technologies.
Skills: Typescript, React & Ruby on Rails. https://github.com/pel-daniel

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Almanac is a platform for async collaboration.
I worked on the document editor that is build with React and ProseMirror. I worked on features like: embeding JIRA issues inside the editor, focus mode and section links.
I was in charge of running standup and retro for the team.

positions.title: Product Software Engineer
positions.description:
Intercom is a customer communications platform that popularized chat support inside websites.
I worked in the pricing and packaging team that owned the pricing page, paywalls and an internal billing tool. During my time there we shipped a new pricing strategy offering 3 solutions: support, customer engagement, and marketing. We also offered a solution for early stage companies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Merit is a platform for verified digital identity.
In the issuer team, I worked on the features for issuers of digital credentials. Like: data ingestion for bulk creation of digital credentials and improving the signup flow. I was part of the rebrand of the whole platform, and the migration of the frontend codebase from Javascript/Flow to Typescript.

positions.title: Founder
positions.locationName: Ciudad de México y alrededores, México
positions.description:
I created animated explanations to teach programming concepts to beginners. 
- LambdaBricks. Visual programming environment for teaching the basics of programming
- Visually explain Higher Order Functions
- Interactive git tutorial & cheatsheet

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ResponsiveLabs was an agency that created digital products with modern technology.
I developed platforms to sell photographs of sporting events, plan baby showers, and a store to sell hand crafted products.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
PriceTravel is one of biggest travel agencies in Mexico.
My work was mostly focused on implementing and consuming web services. For example an internal API to interact with availability and prices of our main products (hotels bookings, flights and tours), an external API to update prices and vacancy of hotel rooms, and integrations with 3rd party anti-fraud tools.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · C# · Redis
